_source: Wowhead Forever drop chances for quest items of the 30-41 route candidates, pulled 11 Nov 2026 (Phase 2 of the 30-60 guide). Item-page numbers are count/outof over all sampled kills; Wowhead Classic shows the same depressed figures for the same items (Bloodscalp Ear 21% vs 17% here), so they are a consistent yardstick rather than the true on-quest rate. Class-quest items (Twisted Totems) are sampled against every player's kills and are far too low to use. 2026-11-12: the quest items of the round-2 (42-50) candidates were added or re-pulled the same way; each row's "source" carries its own pull date, and rows still dated 11 Nov were not re-pulled.
